name: podcast-template
description: Use this template as the starting point for a podcast on your own domain.

paragraphs: This template is a starting point you can use for a podcast on your own domain. We offer: A Jekyll site and an RSS feed that meets Apple Podcasts RSS requirements Episode pages with a timeline, ffmetadata chapter files for ffmpeg, and optional Podcasting 2.0 chapter JSON (including optional chapter images) Yarn scripts for format and lint, including YAML validation Continuous integration to lint and build the site Modern EditorConfig, .gitignore and linting What is in scope for this template? We the people who publish audio on our own domain, in order to keep the feed and the episode pages in…
A weekly conversation, published as a podcast you can subscribe to from the site.
Community Service Hour takes questions, talks through last week's scene, and ships the audio with chapter markers. The site and the feed are this repository. The media files are not.
